svg.text: ESP power + data from PC (no 5V from box)
- Stripe = white wire with that colour (T568B).
- RJ45 pairs: blue X STEP/X DIR, brown Y STEP/Y DIR,
orange LIMIT X/LIMIT Y, green EN/MAG.
- Limit switches: NO, signal -> GPIO (INPUT_PULLUP), other leg -> GND.
- Shield logic (VIO) = 3.3V from ESP GPIO 38 (HIGH first in setup), NOT 5V.
- 12V split at Shield screw terminal (no Wago).
